protocol: CPU0, seed7, 3 alternating pairs; 5 confirmation pairs if median time +20% or RSS +25%. No concurrent own builds/tests. Both builds are O3 without LTO in mus and C-CFR. Solver and bot executables match J21 byte for byte. The match evaluator links the same objects in a different order, so both TXT match workloads are measured. No algorithm source changed.

validation.components_test: Final version passed solver isolation, old archive migration, failed-AR preservation, math linking, default and custom cleanup, and exactly one flags query plus one libraries query on a stable bot build.
validation.final_receipt_refinement: An added query-count test initially found 4 calls caused by mutually expanding recursive exports. The final JSON receipt uses one exported multiline value; the independent probe and full component test then found exactly 2 calls. Receipt content and all measured executable hashes remain unchanged.

postprocessing: Added validation after sampling; original runs and measurement script retained.
observation: All three public candidate match runs are slower than all three parent runs. The +2.338% median wall change is consistent in these pairs, below the gate, and applies to the match evaluation executable; solver and bot are byte-identical.
